actual_failure.status: FAILED PRIVATE_ENVELOPE on first anonymous payroll navigation; browser process executed and cleanup confirmed; zero accepted cases and no accepted durable effect proof

design: Consolidate demonstrated common document response headers into one small SSR-only helper reused by native_account::document and all three html_shell constructors. Root App remains response composition only.

Keep Html content type and exact rendered bytes/status. Common Cache-Control:no-store, Pragma:no-cache, X-Content-Type-Options:nosniff, Referrer-Policy:no-referrer and Vary:Authorization,Cookie,Origin cover the shared root credential dispatch and native metadata; no Set-Cookie is introduced.

Keep the native Account CSP exact. Legacy shells use explicit frame-ancestors none, with object-src none/base-uri none acceptable if included, without introducing default-src/script-src/style-src restrictions that would block their existing inline stylesheet or island bootstrap.

Do not add unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval, rewrite content, externalize assets, change middleware policy, or modify source authorization to repair this response-owner defect. Existing legacy inline execution remains a separately scoped CSP hardening concern, not a newly claimed script-security guarantee.
Change public shell response return type to Response/IntoResponse as required; all existing callers must compile and keep body/status semantics. No asset behavior changes required.
required_tests: Retain the unchanged actual browser PRIVATE_ENVELOPE assertions and rerun the actual database/browser test; its first accepted response alone is not hydration acceptance.

Owner response tests cover html_shell, html_shell_with and html_shell_with_screens for omitted/empty/authorized bodies and appropriate focused screens; parse exact privacy headers and prove body bytes/status preserved.
Native public/sign-in/registration/account/refused/unavailable documents retain their exact restrictive CSP and status/body; Vary includes all three credentials/metadata keys case-insensitively.

Keep native HTTP metadata/HEAD/privacy tests and existing rendering/WASM drift tests; real authorized JS-on filtering with no console/page errors proves the new CSP does not break the existing island.
Reject duplicate/permissive frame-ancestors directives in the new owner oracle, following the existing native structural check; no substring-only CSP oracle for newly authored tests.
premortem: Copied native CSP blocks inline legacy style/bootstrap; existing browser filtering must detect this.
Only the currently used shell gets headers while public helpers remain unsafe; all three actual owners must be exercised.
Shared helper weakens native CSP or drops error status/body; exact retained native assertions detect this.
rollback: Revert this bounded response-owner change without altering database/auth state; preserve failed browser evidence and do not accept privacy regression as a workaround.
holds: No source admission or implementation review granted by this design receipt.
Full release/session-bound read qualification and comprehensive CSP hardening are not established.
